summary: The value, identity, tax label, tax rate, and currency bindings pass. Three caller fields still change trusted output or acceptance state.

blocking_findings.title: Caller school variant metadata changes trusted output and batch classification
blocking_findings.details: The normalizer copies variantId from the caller. It also uses caller ambiguityGroupId values to select ready or unresolved status.
blocking_findings.impact: A caller can change a source variant identifier. A caller can also release an ambiguous batch as ready.
blocking_findings.evidence: One genuine preparation produced Term1 or FORGED-VARIANT when only variantId changed. Two genuine preparations changed from unresolved to ready when only group IDs changed.
blocking_findings.remediation: Add source-stated variant and ambiguity identifiers to the trusted packet. Derive both fields and the ambiguity decision only from those facts.

blocking_findings.title: Caller payment-receipt tax status remains unbound
blocking_findings.details: The payment receipt schema permits two tax statuses. The normalizer copies that caller value into the trusted snapshot.
blocking_findings.impact: One verified receipt packet can produce not-source-asserted or unresolved tax status. The packet contains no fact that selects either result.
blocking_findings.evidence: A genuine preparation produced both status values when only the caller tax status changed.
blocking_findings.remediation: Bind the tax status to a packet fact. A fixed approved status is also safe when the packet cannot state this fact.

nonblocking_findings.title: The reviewed plan fails the formatting check
nonblocking_findings.details: Prettier reported this file only. All reviewed TypeScript files passed the same check.

evidence.manifest_initial: The ordered manifest matched the required SHA-256 aggregate before evidence collection.
evidence.document_identity: The source class, source record, and optional logical reference use singleton packet facts. Contradictory caller values fail closed.
evidence.tax_and_currency: The GST label, GST rate text, and currency come from singleton packet facts. Caller contradictions do not reach output.
evidence.value_identity: Document values use trusted binding IDs. Caller order does not control money or count identity.
evidence.payroll_identity: Payroll values use trusted voucher number, date, money kind, and value bindings. Caller order does not control output.
evidence.duplicates_and_completeness: The normalizer rejects missing bindings, duplicate identities, missing values, extra values, and incomplete payroll vouchers.
evidence.generic_packet_compatibility: The packet schema still accepts a generic legacy packet without normalization bindings.
evidence.receipt_normalization: The reviewed tests and schema use payment-receipt. A receipt value does not satisfy the controlled document schema.

evidence.owner_boundary_tests: The Company Identity suites passed 20 of 20 tests. The Storage suite passed 25 of 25 tests.
